# CodexStation IEF

Canonical public source for the CodexStation Isolated Execution Fabric.

Primary documents:
- README.md — project overview and invariants
- ARCHITECTURE.md — execution architecture and assurance classes
- GOVERNANCE.md — public/private promotion doctrine
- SECURITY.md — security invariants
- ROADMAP.md — specification progression
- specs/CS-IEF-02.md — execution specification/receipt contract
- specs/CS-IEF-03.md — provider ABI and capability negotiation
- specs/CS-IEF-04.md — MicrosandboxProvider reference mapping and qualification gates
- specs/CS-IEF-05.md — fail-closed policy compiler and EAC verifier
- specs/CS-IEF-06.md — ResearchCell and FormalProofCell profile contracts
- specs/CS-IEF-07.md — append-only evidence/IRP witness graph
- schemas/policy-decision.schema.json — machine-readable authorization/rejection evidence
- schemas/cell-profile.schema.json — machine-readable research/proof profile contract
- schemas/evidence-bundle.schema.json — deterministic evidence bundle manifest
- schemas/witness-record.schema.json — machine-readable witness/provenance record
- profiles/research/reproducible.yaml — safe reproducible ResearchCell baseline
- profiles/formal-proof/lean4.yaml — Lean 4 FormalProofCell baseline
- reference/policy_compiler.py — provider-neutral policy compiler skeleton
- reference/profile_compiler.py — purpose-profile constructor skeleton
- reference/witness_graph.py — deterministic append-only witness graph reference
- tests/test_policy_compiler.py — CS-IEF-05 fail-closed vectors
- tests/test_profile_compiler.py — CS-IEF-06 profile/claim-boundary vectors
- tests/test_witness_graph.py — CS-IEF-07 graph/tamper/claim-boundary vectors
- providers/microsandbox/README.md — reference adapter boundary and status
- sources/microsandbox.yaml — pinned reference-provider source manifest

Current verified Microsandbox source snapshot:
- e36792dae06edcd9b6f86abd6b83da7a26c7cdf6

Key rules:
- Microsandbox is a reference provider behind the stable IEF ABI, not the architectural core.
- Feature support is not assurance evidence.
- Policy compilation precedes provider materialization.
- Cell profiles constrain/construct ExecutionSpec; profiles never call providers directly.
- Witness records bind observation, intent, authorization, plan, outcome, evidence, rejection, replication and adjudication without proving semantic truth.
- W2 authorization binds the exact ProviderPlan; W3 outcome binds the exact ExecutionReceipt and EvidenceBundle.
- Rejection is a first-class witness result and is not an execution failure.
- Append-only corrections use new revocation/adjudication records; prior evidence is not rewritten.
- External anchoring proves only what the external system's anchoring semantics support; it does not make underlying claims true.
- Effective authority may narrow automatically but may never silently widen.
- Network remains deny-by-default; research/proof baselines default to no network.
- Reproducibility claims cannot exceed captured evidence.
- FORMALLY_CHECKED is bounded to the pinned external prover target/toolchain/dependencies and does not imply empirical truth, novelty, or peer-review status.
- Stale or absent qualification cannot authorize an EAC.
- No EAC-3 assignment exists until active-environment qualification passes.
- Provider-specific types must remain below the stable IEF kernel boundary.
